problem_statement: Tourists need a simple, fast way to reserve a car. Currently there is no online booking system â€” customers must call or visit in person. A web-based car reservation system will let customers browse available cars, select dates, and confirm bookings online.

requirements.text: Customers can browse available cars by name, type, and availability status.
Customers can select pickup and return dates and receive validation before booking.
Customers can submit a booking with their email and name. PII (email, name) must be encrypted at rest.
Customers can request deletion of their personal data (right-to-erasure) per GDPR requirements.

data_retention: 90 days from last activity, or immediately upon deletion request
